goal: Give a user or local agent the fullest Apple Photos insight available through osxphotos-class catalog access, original-file metadata, and PhotoKit, while keeping publication closed and catalog writes narrowly bounded.

capabilities.label: Library identity and source continuity
capabilities.insight: Library and database versions, frozen source scope, stable asset count, and digest-bound membership continuity.

capabilities.label: Asset identity and technical properties
capabilities.insight: Stable UUID, current and original filenames, media kind and subtype, dimensions, file size, UTI, availability, cloud or missing state, and reference status where available.

capabilities.label: Dates, time zones, and import history
capabilities.insight: Creation, addition, modification, import-session, and time-zone context where the Photos version exposes it.

capabilities.label: Original embedded metadata
capabilities.insight: Locally available EXIF, IPTC, XMP, GPS, camera and lens, orientation, color, maker-note, QuickTime, and other ImageIO or ExifTool properties from the original asset or sidecars.

capabilities.label: Photos-authored metadata
capabilities.insight: Title, description, keywords, favorite, hidden, trashed, edit state, external-edit state, and other user-authored catalog fields.

capabilities.label: Albums, folders, and library structure
capabilities.insight: Album memberships, nested folder paths, smart and shared context where exposed, projects, moments, and import sessions.

capabilities.label: People, pets, and face relationships
capabilities.insight: Existing named People and Pets associations, face counts, face records, and face crops where available; never inferred names for unnamed faces.

capabilities.label: Places and location
capabilities.insight: Coordinates, reverse-geocoded place hierarchy, and location availability, kept exact only in the private workspace.

capabilities.label: Apple computational context
capabilities.insight: Classification and search labels, activities, holidays, venues, detected text descriptions, aesthetic and component scores, promotion, curation, and failure signals where available.

capabilities.label: Variants and related assets
capabilities.insight: Original and edited resources, Live Photo still and video, RAW+JPEG pairs, bursts, adjustments and sidecars, duplicates, and related capture groups.

capabilities.label: Sharing and social context
capabilities.insight: Shared albums or library state, syndication, comments, likes, and contributor context where the Photos version makes them available.

capabilities.label: Query, export, and sidecars
capabilities.insight: Compound metadata queries, template fields, complete private JSON records, originals and edited exports, Live and RAW components, metadata sidecars, and dry-run reports.

capabilities.label: Local visual inspection
capabilities.insight: Offline pixels, metadata-minimized review previews, local labels, face counts, and ephemeral OCR safety flags, with no upload.

capabilities.label: Bounded Photos writes
capabilities.insight: Create approved folders and albums and add existing membership only, followed by independent read-only verification and an idempotence receipt.
